name: Cookie 4IS
source:
She is one of the new IS series robots built by [url=/c56316]Tsugaru[/url]. Due to some events, Cookie 4IS was looking for a new master and thanks to [url=/c3885]Yamato[/url] and [url=/c56722]Cookie 4[/url], she can stay at the Shimazu dorm. She refers to people who are her temporary master as well as her real master as meisters.

[From [url=http://majikoi.wikia.com/wiki/Cookie_4IS]Majikoi Wiki[/url]]
